notifications.title: Notifications and diagnostics
notifications.description: Pauses apply per identified discovery, not to an entire integration. 0 hours disables them (default); maximum 720 hours (30 days). The period starts with the last emitted event. New addresses remain separate. History and counters continue updating; discovery flows stay active. Diagnostics also require DEBUG logging for custom_components.discovery_monitor.

confirm_model.description: Ignore all reliably recognized devices of model {model} in {integration}, including other Bluetooth addresses. This discovery's current flow will be removed. Other models remain allowed.

recent_findings.title: Recent discoveries
recent_findings.description: Recent discoveries are shown directly as a list. Select a discovery to manage. Technical identifiers and fingerprints are not displayed.

finding_action.title: Manage discovery
finding_action.description: Choose whether to hide {name} from this list or ignore matching future discoveries. Only safe ignore choices are shown.

ignored_items.title: Ignored devices and device types
ignored_items.description: All ignore rules are shown directly as a list. Select an item to allow matching future discoveries again. Historical records are retained.
